# Shellui documentation

> Shellui is a free, open-source web app platform (MIT). It gives your apps a shared shell with navigation, authentication, administration, and storage built in, so teams stop rebuilding the basics. Main site: https://shellui.com. Source: https://github.com/shellui/shellui.

## Start here

- [Introduction](https://docs.shellui.com/): what Shellui is and how the pieces fit
- [Installation](https://docs.shellui.com/installation): install the CLI and core packages
- [Quickstart](https://docs.shellui.com/quickstart): create and run a first project
- [Framework starters](https://docs.shellui.com/framework-starters): starters for common frameworks

## Packages

- [@shellui/core](https://docs.shellui.com/core): the shell and its configuration
- [@shellui/sdk](https://docs.shellui.com/sdk): SDK used by apps running inside the shell
- [@shellui/cli](https://docs.shellui.com/cli): command line for init, dev, build, and deploy
- [Backend](https://docs.shellui.com/backend): connecting the shell to Shellui services
- [Desktop with Tauri](https://docs.shellui.com/tauri): ship the shell as a desktop app

## Features

- [Navigation](https://docs.shellui.com/features/navigation)
- [Authentication](https://docs.shellui.com/features/authentication)
- [Administration](https://docs.shellui.com/features/administration)
- [Storage](https://docs.shellui.com/features/storage)
- [Themes](https://docs.shellui.com/features/themes)
- [Internationalization](https://docs.shellui.com/features/internationalization)
- [Layouts](https://docs.shellui.com/features/layouts)
- [Security](https://docs.shellui.com/features/security)

## Services

- [Identity service](https://docs.shellui.com/identity/): sign-in, OAuth, magic links, SAML, SCIM
- [Storage service](https://docs.shellui.com/storage/): file uploads and access
- [Email service](https://docs.shellui.com/email/): templates, providers, newsletters, rules
- [Hosting service](https://docs.shellui.com/hosting/): deploy and serve Shellui apps

## Optional

- [Development](https://docs.shellui.com/development): contributing to Shellui
- [Publishing](https://docs.shellui.com/publishing): release process for the packages
